verdicts.reason: A reads properly left to right: brand, headline, body, then badges and a strong CTA on the right. Its flaws: the circle and can are shrunk to a tiny clipped thumbnail at the left edge, the badge text is very small, and the body copy nearly touches the bottom edge. B breaks up the design: the circle sits empty on the left while the can floats alone far to the right, the SOLSTICE wordmark drops below the headline, the CTA comes before the badges, the body copy is too small to read, and there is large dead space on the right.
